description: This wildfire simulator is developed by Anastasios Tsolakis as a Python package for fire spread on raster land-cover maps. It uses a cellular-automata representation and links vegetation classes to flammability, with Matplotlib visualisation. Inputs are a GeoTIFF land-cover raster and an ignition point selected on the map; outputs show the evolving burned area through the simulation. Geographic extent and cell size follow the selected raster; the README recommends the Copernicus 2020 10-m land-cover product but does not establish a calibrated physical time step. Source is free under MIT and installation instructions list rasterio and GDAL requirements. A limitation is that the documented simple spread rules and vegetation mapping do not establish predictive accuracy for operational wildfire response. The model can support exploratory hazard-exposure scenarios. GisFIRE (platform-gisfire) offers related wildfire data preparation and analysis. No land-cover map, animation or model archive was downloaded.
name: Raster cellular-automata wildfire simulator
